text:
Mira: Heads-up — after the deploy this morning we're seeing memory growth on long-context jobs (seq_len ~6k) that wasn't present on canary.
Sam: saw that in CI too, perf-run flagged higher RSS and a couple OOMs on the L64 tests.
Chen: can you paste the profiler output?
Mira: here's the flamegraph snippet from the failing runner:
```
alloc_objects: 1.2GB
kv_cache_entries: 820k
kv_cache_evictions: 12k
kernel_select: cpu->fp16_copy path triggered a lot more allocations
```
Mira: notice kernel_select switching to a fallback path for some layers — looks like the new batching-based handoff causes slightly different kernel routing when batch headroom is low.
Priya: batching heuristic change in PR #4217 made headroom calculation prefer larger micro-batches which can increase KV cache retention windows.
Sam: bisected to 9f3b7a2 (kernel-routing: prefer fp16_copy when seq_len>2048); reverting that commit removes the OOMs in my repro.
Chen: interesting — kernel path itself doesn't allocate big buffers but it delays KV eviction because requests stick around longer in the batching window.
Mira: repro command I used:
```bash
./perf_run --model redwood-7b --seq-len 6000 --qps 10 --batching=auto --profile=allocs
```
Priya: infra-bot says CI perf: https://ci/redwood/12345 -> memory delta +18% on longctx suite.
infra-bot: :warning: Job perf/longctx-matrix failed 2/6 runs: increased peak RSS and 1 OOM. Link: https://ci/redwood/12345
Sam: quick mitigation — can we tweak the batching headroom back to the previous formula to reduce dwell time?
Mira: yes, or we can force kernel routing to previous path for seq_len>4096 while we investigate. Leaning revert + small tweak to batching as safe.
Chen: I'll open a revert PR and add a unit test covering KV eviction under long-running micro-batches.
Priya: also flagging this as a rollout blocker for the release until we get parity in memory profiles.
Mira: adding perf logs and a short checklist in the PR — please include steps to reproduce and the exact alloc flame.
Sam: thanks — assign to me for the follow-up perf investigation after revert. :thumbsup:
Mira: great, keeping this thread for updates. If anyone sees similar OOMs in other suites ping here.
